name: Marko Babić
bio:
Marko's fascination with motorsport began in his youth, attending local hill climb races in Croatia. He was immediately captivated by the raw power and engineering ingenuity on display. Though initially pursuing a degree in general engineering, he refocused his studies on aerodynamics after witnessing a particularly innovative spoiler design on a rally car. He landed his first role at a small racing team, quickly proving his aptitude for data analysis and wind tunnel testing. 

Marko believes that a successful aero package is not just about maximizing downforce; it's about achieving a harmonious balance with the car's overall dynamics. He's meticulous in his approach, poring over simulations and real-world data to identify even the smallest areas for improvement. While his technical skills are still developing, his relentless dedication and unwavering belief in the power of innovation set him apart. He excels at creating a collaborative environment where ideas can flourish, even if it means challenging conventional wisdom.

His calm demeanor allows him to stay focused and make clear-headed decisions, even under immense pressure. He's eager to apply his visionary approach to a larger stage and contribute to a team's success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Marko is of average height, with a thoughtful expression and a lean build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches and calculations
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought
Insists on having a specific type of Croatian coffee before every race weekend
